newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to buy 378,000 tonnes of Australian wheat.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to buy 378,000 tonnes of Australian wheat.

text.p: Pakistan has decided to buy 378,000 tonnes of Australian white wheat for delivery in June and July, a senior government official said on Thursday.
Secretary to the Ministry of Food and Agriculture, Mahboob Ahmad, told Reuters the wheat will come in eight consignments of 47,250 each.
"I know we are buying wheat from Australia this time but I have no idea of the price yet," Ahmed added.
Grain traders in Paris said there was widespread talk that Pakistan had bought 400,000 tonnes of Australian wheat at $171-172 per tonne FOB.
Ahmed said he would know the details on Friday.
